properties.description: Enforces exact-one collection cardinality and builds the selected item URL.
properties.script:
import json
import sys

status, statusCode, message, resultJson, ready = "ok", 200, "Exact definition resolved", "{}", False
definitionMoid = definitionItemUrl = ""
try:
    body = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    name, version, organizationMoid = sys.argv[2], int(sys.argv[3]), sys.argv[4]
    rows = body.get("Results") if isinstance(body,dict) else None
    if not isinstance(rows,list): raise ValueError("Definition response does not contain a Results array.")
    exact = [row for row in rows if row.get("Name") == name and int(row.get("Version",0)) == version and isinstance(row.get("Organization"),dict) and row["Organization"].get("Moid") == organizationMoid]
    if len(exact) != len(rows):
        status, statusCode = "identity-mismatch", 409
        message = "Definition response contains an identity outside the exact requested filter."
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error":message,"returnedCount":len(rows),"exactCount":len(exact)}, separators=(",", ":"))
    elif len(exact) != 1:
        status = "not-found" if len(exact) == 0 else "conflict"
        statusCode = 404 if len(exact) == 0 else 409
        message = "Definition identity must resolve exactly one result; received %d." % len(exact)
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error":message,"resultCount":len(exact)}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        definitionMoid = str(exact[0].get("Moid") or "")
        if not definitionMoid: raise ValueError("Selected definition has no Moid.")
        definitionItemUrl = "/api/v1/workload/WorkloadDefinitions/" + definitionMoid
        resultJson = json.dumps({"selected":exact[0]}, separators=(",", ":"))
    ready = True
except Exception as exc:
    status, statusCode, message = "malformed", 502, str(exc)
    resultJson, ready = json.dumps({"error":message}, separators=(",", ":")), True

properties.description: Maps every normalized selector to exactly one accessible local or shared catalog and builds one combined blueprint query.
properties.script:
import json
import sys

status, statusCode, message, resultJson, ready = "ok", 200, "Catalog selectors resolved", "{}", False
resolvedConfigsJson = "[]"
blueprintUrl = "/api/v1/workload/Blueprints?$filter=Moid eq '000000000000000000000000'"
try:
    body = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    configs = json.loads(sys.argv[2])
    organizationMoid = sys.argv[3]
    rows = body.get("Results") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(rows, list) or not isinstance(configs, list):
        raise ValueError("Catalog response or normalized configuration has the wrong shape.")
    resolved = []
    for config in configs:
        if config["CatalogSelectorType"] == "Moid":
            matches = [row for row in rows if row.get("Moid") == config["CatalogMoid"]]
        else:
            matches = [row for row in rows if row.get("Name") == config["CatalogName"]]
        eligible = []
        for row in matches:
            relation = row.get("Organization")
            relatedMoid = relation.get("Moid") if isinstance(relation, dict) else ""
            if not relatedMoid or relatedMoid == organizationMoid:
                eligible.append(row)
        if len(eligible) != 1:
            status = "not-found" if len(eligible) == 0 else "conflict"
            statusCode = 404 if len(eligible) == 0 else 409
            message = "Each catalog selector must resolve exactly one accessible catalog; selector for %s returned %d. Use CatalogMoid for ambiguous shared/local names." % (config["Name"], len(eligible))
            break
        copy = dict(config)
        copy["ResolvedCatalogMoid"] = eligible[0]["Moid"]
        resolved.append(copy)
    if status == "ok":
        clauses = []
        for config in resolved:
            clause = "Catalog.Moid eq '%s' and Name eq '%s'" % (config["ResolvedCatalogMoid"], config["BlueprintName"].replace("'", "''"))
            clause += " and DefaultVersion eq true" if config["VersionSelection"] == "Default" else " and Version eq %d" % config["Version"]
            clauses.append("(" + clause + ")")
        blueprintUrl = "/api/v1/workload/Blueprints?$filter=" + (" or ".join(clauses) if clauses else "Moid eq '000000000000000000000000'")
        resolvedConfigsJson = json.dumps(resolved, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False)
        resultJson = json.dumps({"resolvedCatalogCount": len(resolved)}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error": message}, separators=(",", ":"))
    ready = True
except Exception as exc:
    status, statusCode, message = "malformed", 502, str(exc)
    resultJson, ready = json.dumps({"error": message}, separators=(",", ":")), True

properties.script:
import json
import sys
status,statusCode,message,resultJson,ready="ok",200,"Patched definition verified","{}",False
definitionMoid=updatedResultJson=""
try:
 body=json.loads(sys.argv[1]);org=body.get("Organization") if isinstance(body,dict) else None
 if not isinstance(body,dict) or body.get("Moid")!=sys.argv[2] or body.get("Name")!=sys.argv[3] or int(body.get("Version",0))!=int(sys.argv[4]) or not isinstance(org,dict) or org.get("Moid")!=sys.argv[5]: status,statusCode,message="identity-mismatch",409,"PATCH response identity changed.";resultJson=json.dumps({"error":message,"response":body},separators=(",",":"))
 else:
  definitionMoid=body["Moid"]
  outputBody=dict(body)
  outputBody["WorkflowConcurrencyDiagnostic"]={"PriorGetModTime":sys.argv[6] or None,"IfMatchSent":False,"GetPatchRace":"The definition may have changed after GET and before this unguarded PATCH."}
  updatedResultJson=json.dumps(outputBody,separators=(",",":"),ensure_ascii=False)
  resultJson=updatedResultJson
 ready=True
except Exception as exc: status,statusCode,message,resultJson,ready="malformed",502,str(exc),json.dumps({"error":str(exc)},separators=(",",":")),True

Updates selected writable fields on one exact Cisco Unified Edge workload definition version while preserving all unselected fields. Empty optional strings mean omitted, so clearing Description to an empty string is not supported by this v1 input model. Blueprint replacement requires Status Inactive, exact validated blueprint resolution, and complete replacement input arrays; Tags is also a complete replacement. The Generic Cisco Intersight API Request atomic exposes no supported conditional-header input, so the PATCH sends no If-Match; prior ModTime is diagnostic only and a GET/PATCH race remains. HTTP 412 is treated only as a generic server conflict. Workload validation behavior requires live-tenant testing.
